title: Aircraft
description: DRAFT, finalized in Phase 3 (lineage view). One airframe's full life story, published as aircraft/{airframe_id}.json and loaded when the user selects an aircraft. Rules JSON Schema can't check: history arrays are sorted by start (null first), then end; airline_id values reference airlines.json; source_ids reference sources.json.

type_code.description: ICAO type designator, or null if unknown.

family.description: Type family; 'other' for types that can't be mapped.

line_number.description: Production line number, or null if unknown.

built.description: When the aircraft was built, or null if unknown.

status.description: Lifecycle status, or null if unknown. Consumers must handle values added later.

current.description: Where the aircraft is now, for linking back to the circle pack.

airline_id.description: Airline whose current fleet lists the aircraft, or null if none.

reg.description: Current registration, or null if unknown or deregistered.

operator_tenures.description: Who flew the aircraft over time; the lanes of the lineage view.

ownership_tenures.description: Who owned the aircraft over time, often a lessor or bank trustee rather than the operator.

photos.description: Photos of the aircraft, sorted by taken_at (null last); the livery gallery.

period.title: Period
period.description: Start and end of a history record. A null start means unknown; a null end means ongoing or unknown.

start.description: When the period started, or null if unknown.

end.description: When the period ended, or null if ongoing or unknown.

icao24.description: ICAO 24-bit address used with this registration, as 6 uppercase hex digits, or null if unknown.

country.description: Country of registry, or null if unknown.

operatorTenure.title: OperatorTenure
operatorTenure.description: A period with one operator, or a gap (storage, unknown).

airline_id.description: Operating airline, or null for storage, unknown gaps or operators not in airlines.json.

operator_name.description: Operator name as found in the source, for operators without an airline_id; null otherwise.

kind.description: operated: normal operation; wet_lease: flown for another airline; stored: parked between operators; unknown: gap in the data.

owner_name.description: Owner as named in the source.

owner_kind.description: Kind of owner, or null if unknown.

airline_id.description: Airline, when the owner is one in airlines.json; null otherwise.

photo.title: AircraftPhoto
photo.description: A photo, matched to the livery and registration it shows where possible.

airline_id.description: Airline whose livery the photo shows, or null if unmatched.

reg.description: Registration visible in the photo, or null if unknown.

stats.title: AircraftStats
stats.description: Summary figures. Values derivable from the arrays above (e.g. time per operator) are left to the app.

operator_count.description: Distinct operators, excluding storage and unknown gaps.

observed_flights.description: Flights seen in ADS-B data, or null if not measured.

first_seen.description: First month seen in ADS-B data, or null if not measured.

last_seen.description: Last month seen in ADS-B data, or null if not measured.
